notes.title: Update Preview
notes.content:
﻿I haven't released any news for a long time. It's not that I ran away. It's that I have been working all day and night. Now I have done a phase, so I will release some completed content:

1. Skill tree: There are a total of 8 active skills and 24 passive skills, which can be categorized into 4 schools, and players can freely mix and match skills
﻿
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44666271/f5ebdbff78814598d40361e381de077c36b8dd2b.jpg[/img]
﻿
﻿
﻿
﻿
2. Stockings can be freely matched with clothes
﻿
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44666271/d3445ab4fb6060cbcb12488251afb5068922a8e1.jpg[/img]
﻿
﻿
﻿
3. The skin material of the protagonist has been redone, and now it's possible to get wet
﻿
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44666271/0b507c71e03e96e2e8551c3d6256c047a120939a.jpg[/img]
﻿
﻿
﻿
I'm still working on the main storyline and NPC-related content. Once completed, we will update them together

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44666271/92750027ef9a2a805b321b8cd77091dd5041425d.jpg[/img]

notes.title: 2024-3-9 Update Instructions
notes.content:
I'm sorry that it took so long to update. The main problem is that the illusory engine has caused problems. It took 10 days to pack and report errors. Then the illusory engine was upgraded to 5.3 and no errors were reported. However, 5.3 had serious performance problems. I even made two completely different levels in the fourth level of defense mode, one of which was abandoned due to the performance of 5.3. O (╥ ﹏ ╥) o

Then when I returned to version 5.0, there was still no way to report errors. I tried all the possible methods (the illusory engine was reinstalled, the game version was rolled back to 1.0 with svn, and the system was reinstalled). It was an error when packaging the compressed file, and I couldn't find out what the problem was. O (╥ ﹏ ╥) o

There is no way out. It took 20 days to solve the problem. No one on the Internet made the same mistake. Sorry, the final solution is to change the compression method, so this update has a full 15G. O (╥ ﹏ ╥) o

The following is the content of this update:

1. Updated the fourth level of defense mode

2. Now shield will be ignored for falling damage

3. Reduces the probability of the enemy shooting through the wall

4. Replaced some UI images

5. Modified the compression algorithm of the game to reduce the hard disk capacity occupied by the game

6. Fixed the problem of not giving parts in some cases when settling in defensive mode

notes.title: 2024-1-20 Major Update Description
notes.content:
1. Added a new defense mode (a brand new game mode, the initial weapon is the BIG SHARK, unlimited time, monsters refresh wave by wave, each wave will be enhanced, each wave provides 3 optional upgrade options, each 3 wave randomly refreshes a weapon on the map, rewards based on the number of monsters killed and rating)

2. All weapons have added mobility attributes (mobility affects player's turning and movement speed)

3. The monster has increased its health bar

4. BOSS has increased BOSS health bar

5. New damage indicator (can display the direction of damage)

6. Greatly improved the ability of bullets to penetrate walls

7. Rework of LONE WOLF Pistol

8. Greatly increased the damage of grenade launchers (enemy damage remains unchanged)

9. Slightly reduced the damage of NORTH STAR

10. Increased the maximum ammunition carrying capacity of all weapons

11. Reduced the health and damage of most monsters

12. Some zombies may vomit poison

13. Increased difficulty gradient

14. Wooden boxes now prioritize dropping bullets, grenades, and medicine packs (including revolver bullets)

15. Optimized the collision of the boss, making it difficult for the boss to get stuck. At the same time, optimized the speed of some of the boss's attacks, allowing players to have more escape time

16. Now the boss will give a Gold Target (of normal difficulty or above)

17. Now there is a prompt to obtain the Gold Target

18. Redo the opening effect of the treasure chest

19. Remake special effects for bullets, grenades, and medication items

20. Now players can switch guns while running

21. Optimized and unified display of all damage numbers

22. Adjusted the display effect of some UI

23. Fixed occasional drop to ground death at the base

24. Fixed some other minor issues
